final.memo:
the Company continues to execute according to the thesis established during our long-standing venture relationship [D01]. Reported Q3 2020 results showed robust revenue growth of 32.1% year-over-year and an encouraging expansion in operating margins to 18.7%, providing initial validation of the AI-driven credit underwriting model [D03]. 

The rapid appreciation of the share price to $62.19—more than triple the $20 IPO price—has significantly compressed the margin of safety [D04]. While we are pleased with the market's reception, we are not in the business of letting sentiment replace valuation discipline [D03]. We continue to hold while we await the first full public earnings cycle and detailed loan cohort performance to confirm that the business model is not merely a beneficiary of a favorable macro environment [D03; D05].

Risks remain, particularly regarding model performance in a credit cycle not fully captured in the firm's training data [D05]. We will continue to monitor the platform's ability to maintain partner demand and underwriting accuracy [D05]. Our focus remains on the fundamentals—repeat demand, unit economics, and the ability of the fee platform to sustain margins through economic volatility—rather than the current trading multiple [D01; D04].
